practice.question: Can a causal global token at position zero collect the complete future document?
practice.answer: No. It can collect only keys at positions zero or earlier. Symmetric encoder global attention would leak the future in this decoder setting.

practice.question: For W=3,L=4, what is the largest causal input span including self?
practice.answer: 1+4*(3-1)=9 positions, clipped at the sequence start. This is possible reachability, not guaranteed retrieval quality.
practice.rubric: Use W-1 and distinguish reachability from learned information.
